cues: In heterogeneous catalysis the catalyst is in a different phase, usually a solid surface.
Making vanaspati ghee: hydrogen and vegetable oil are adsorbed on nickel.
Adsorption weakens the hydrogen bond and holds the molecules in the right orientation.
They react, and the solid fat desorbs, freeing the surface.
text: In heterogeneous catalysis the catalyst is in a different phase, usually a solid surface. Making vanaspati ghee: hydrogen and vegetable oil are adsorbed on nickel. Adsorption weakens the hydrogen bond and holds the molecules in the right orientation. They react, and the solid fat desorbs, freeing the surface.
